children: on Friday announced that the U.S. FDA granted full approval for an all-oral regimen containing its estrogen receptor antagonist Inluriyo and kinase inhibitor Verzenio as a late-line option for breast cancer.

Specifically, the approval clears the combo for adults with estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) breast cancer with an ESR1 mutation whose disease has progressed following one or more lines of prior endocrine therapy. The treatment is indicated for those with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

Inluriyo belongs to a novel drug class known as oral selective estrogen receptor degraders. Roche’s
oral SERD giredestrant is currently under FDA priority review for ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, with a decision expected by Nov. 30.
